name: close
description:
The Close MCP server is a secure, standardized interface that lets Claude directly access and interact with your Close data. Core functionality with Claude:

• Connects Close to Claude via the Model Context Protocol so Claude can use Close as a trusted system of record.

• Read data (e.g., leads, contacts, opportunities, activities) based on your Close permissions.

• Optionally write data — you can allow only safe writes (e.g., create a lead) or full writes (e.g., edit/delete) during setup.

• Enables Claude to answer questions, summarize information, and perform actions in Close.

tool.name: get_ai_credit_usage
tool.description:
AI credit usage for the billing account, broken down by feature.

Reports total credits used and a per-feature breakdown. Credits
are the billing unit for AI features. Usage covers the whole
billing account, not a single organization. Omit `start`/`end`
for the current billing period; the result's `start`/`end` report
the window actually measured.
Explicit ranges must be timezone-aware and span at most 366 days.
Older ranges may return empty or partial data — zero usage for an
old range does not mean no activity. On a rate-limited error,
retry after `retry_after` seconds.

start.description: Start of the measured period: the requested start, or the billing period start if the range was omitted. The queried window is minute-aligned.

tool.name: get_billing_summary
tool.description:
Billing summary for the organization's billing account.

Reports the subscription plan, billing status with the trial end
date, seat counts, and AI usage availability, tier, and credit
allowance for the current billing cycle. Whether the account is on
trial is `status`, not anything under `ai_usage`. Use
`get_ai_credit_usage` for the credits actually used.

status.description: Billing status of the account, and the only signal for whether it is on trial: `trial` is an active trial, `trial_expired` a lapsed one, `paying` a converted account. The rest are inactive. AI usage can be blocked during a trial, so this is independent of `ai_usage.availability_status`.

free_credits.description: Credit allowance included at no extra charge for the current billing cycle: the plan's per-seat allowance, or the fixed trial allowance while the account is on trial, plus any bonus credits.

tier_credits.description: Monthly credit allowance of the selected paid AI usage tier. 0 means the free tier is selected; null means no tier is selected, including trial and unconfigured states.

total_credits.description: Total credit allowance for the current billing cycle: `free_credits` plus `tier_credits`. Check `availability_status` before describing credits as usable, and use `get_ai_credit_usage` for credits actually used.

availability_status.description: The state of usage for an account.

ai_usage.description: AI usage availability, tier, and total credit allowance. Null only when the account has no AI usage status record.

plan_version.description: Version of the plan lineup the plan belongs to; plans with the same name can differ across versions.

trial_ends_at.description: When the trial ends or ended (UTC). Null if the account never had a trial.

free_seat_count.description: Number of seats granted to the account for free and not charged for.

billable_seat_count.description: Number of seats the account is charged for. Excludes free seats and non-billable users.

tool.name: get_voice_agent_overview_report
tool.description:
Cross-agent rollup for the Voice Agents list page.

Returns one row per **active** agent — agents with completed calls
in `date_range` **or** queued upcoming calls. Cumulative funnel
counts (`answered`, `engaged`, `objective_met`) plus `total_calls`.
`upcoming_calls` is the agent's queued (not yet completed) calls and
is **not** bound by `date_range` — open tasks are open regardless of
when scheduled (so an agent with only upcoming calls still appears).
Use this to compare agents;
for one agent's outcomes, sentiment, or time saved use
`get_voice_agent_performance_report`. For an inventory of all
configured voice agents regardless of activity, use
`find_agent_configs`.

The Voice Agents list (Agents tab) shows all-time stats, so leave
`date_range` at its default (`all_time`) unless the user asks for a
specific window. (The Upcoming and Recent tabs are call lists, not
this rollup — search Calls for those.)

Rows are sorted server-side per the `sort` field (default
`most_calls`); pass a different mode rather than re-sorting in
your reply. Set `reverse=True` to invert (e.g. `sort=most_calls,
reverse=True` for least active first) — necessary to surface the
bottom of the ordering, since `rows` are capped before they reach
you. `truncated` and `total_agent_count` flag in-scope active
agents; `dormant_agent_count` reports in-scope agents with
**neither** completed calls in the date range **nor** queued
upcoming calls (not included in `rows`).
